title: Who and How? Adverse Selection and flexible Moral Hazard
abstract: arXiv:2506.12979v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We characterize incentive-compatible mechanisms in environments with hidden types and flexible hidden actions. Our approach introduces extended recommendation schedules that also prescribe actions off path, after misreports. This yields a tractable and complete characterization of incentive compatibility, which includes a generalized integral monotonicity condition capturing the interaction between adverse selection and moral hazard. We illustrate the usefulness of the characterization in a range of applications, including franchise agreements, employment contracts, and optimal taxation, covering both risk neutrality and risk aversion, with and without limited liability. Among other results, we identify a broad class of environments in which menus of affine contracts are optimal for a profit maximizing principal.

translated_title: 谁来做与如何做？逆向选择与灵活的道德风险
translated_abstract: 我们刻画了在存在隐藏类型与灵活隐藏行为的环境中的激励相容机制。我们的方法引入了扩展的推荐方案，这些方案在代理人误报之后（偏离均衡路径时）也规定了其应采取的行动。由此得到一个易于处理且完整的激励相容刻画，其中包含一个广义积分单调性条件，该条件捕捉了逆向选择与道德风险之间的相互作用。我们通过一系列应用展示了这一刻画的有用性，包括特许经营协议、雇佣合同以及最优税收问题，同时涵盖了风险中性与风险厌恶的情形，以及有无有限责任约束的情况。在其他结果中，我们识别出了一大类环境，在这些环境中，仿射合同的菜单对于以利润最大化为目标的委托人而言是最优的。
tldr: 本文通过引入规定误报后偏离路径行为的扩展推荐方案，完整刻画了同时存在逆向选择与灵活道德风险的环境下的激励相容机制，并识别出一类广泛环境，其中仿射合同菜单对利润最大化的委托人是最优的。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a tractable and complete characterization of incentive-compatible mechanisms under both adverse selection and flexible moral hazard by introducing extended recommendation schedules that prescribe off-path actions after misreports, and identifies broad environments where menus of affine contracts are optimal for a profit-maximizing principal.
